headline: Build Your Travel Watch Kit, $12K total
stop_reason: Stopped before drafting. Only two tiers have clean, same-height studio photos: a field watch (Hamilton Khaki Field H69529933, $795, 2026-11-22) and a dress watch (Oris Artelier 01 733 7810 4051, $2,200, 2026-11-22). The Seiko SPB121 photo is a 'coming soon' placeholder, the Tissot Le Locle has a smudge, the IWC Portofino is a dress watch not a GMT or chronograph, and the Longines Master L2.949.4.73.6 would duplicate the dress tier. No clean GMT or chronograph photo was found in the library, so the third tier is missing. Next step: source a clean studio photo for one GMT or chronograph model priced up to $6,000 (add to the library), then re-run.
